sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every three years as 
indicated by Y3 in the title block

The technical specification of 
irrigation gateno. 8. The discharge in full opening 3.15 is 365 m3/sec

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Wagdy Roshdy Habeb, tested by eng.Samy Shehata 
Ebrahim, accepted by eng.

Hanafy 
Fahmy Madny general director, approved by eng. Abd El Kerim Abu Zeid Ismail Head 
Sector of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, and certified by eng. Kamel 
Ragheb Hakem MPIS HPGC Coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Switch off the power supply for the gate.
The tunnel must be empty.
Lowering six DS stop loges in even slot.
Install a fixed wooden platform
Wear safety equipment as safety belt, shoes ... etc.
Use lights 36 v.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Check up the oil level in 
the tank.

Check up the oil level in 
the hinge.

Check up the oil leakage 
in all joins of the gate.

Check up and calibrate all 
the manometers.

Check up the mechanical 
parts at complete opening and complete closing and partial opening and check the 
time and pressure.
تحقق من الحماية.

Check up the oil leakage 
from the backing box and servomotor shaft and tight all the bolts.

Check up, clean and grease 
the rope of transmission moving.

فحص المفصلة والزيت 
تسرب منه.

Check up the servomotor 
shaft and repair any corrosion.

Install wood platform 
after openIing the gate in mantenace opening.

Check up the water seal of 
the gate and change if necessary.

Check up the corrosion or 
cavitations in the gate.

Check up and clean the 
filters and all pipes.

Check up the bolts and all 
the metallic parts.

Check up the reduction and 
non-retum valves.

Check up ,clean and 
grease the bearing.
Clean and paint the gate.
